creation.musicLyricsGuide: Aw ye cogoya ni kan ɲɛfɔ aw ka ɲinini kɔnɔ. Aw ye dɔnkiliw da tagamasiɲɛw jukɔrɔ minnu bɛ duguma. {{instrumental}} dabila kankanw kama.
creation.setupAllDownload: Fɛn bɛɛ telesarse ani k’a labɛn a yɛrɛma
creation.setupStorage: Filenw bɛɛ lajɛlen : {{download}}. Lakanali: {{reserve}}. Yɔrɔ wɛrɛw ka kan ka sɔrɔ: {{required}}. Furu disiki sugandilen kan: {{free}}.
creation.setupSpaceMissing: {{missing}} tununna. Yɔrɔ hɔrɔnyalen don walima ka disiki wɛrɛ sugandi min kɔnɔfɛnw bɛ se ka marayɔrɔ bɛrɛbɛrɛ.
creation.setupTextNote: Sɛbɛnni dɔrɔn fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛ min bɛ kɛ baro, sɛbɛnni, baarakɛminɛnw ani jaabiw labɛnni na. Télécharger: {{size}} ko la. A bɛ hakilijagabɔ caman de wajibiya ka tɛmɛ {{defaultModel}} kan wa a tɛ ja walima lamɛntaw yɛrɛ baara. Jaabi minnu bɛ fɔ, olu bɛ baara kɛ ni sistɛmu kan ye. A sugandi sɛbɛnni baara kama ni i hakili bɛ se ka kɛ. Jaabi lakikaw lajɛ ni sɔrɔyɔrɔw ye.
creation.setupImageNote: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Q4_K_M bɛ ja dɔw lawuli; Qwen3 bɛ ɲɛfɔli kode ani VAE bɛ ja laban bɔ. Aw bɛ aspect ratio, resolution, seed, steps ani upscaling ladilan. Ladilikan fɔlɔ: 21:9, sen naani ani kisɛ gansan.
creation.setupMusicNote: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo bɛ dongili minɛnw walima donkow dilan. Laɲinikɛla bɛ baarakɛ cogo dilan; 2B Q4_K_M ka dilanni bɛ kɛ, sɛbɛnni sariya bɛ ɲɛfɔ ani VAE ka dekɔdi sterɔ 48 kHz kumakan. Ka wagati laben, kumakan cogo, temɛ, kumakanw, kan, siraw ani kisɛ. A ka kan: 30 sɛkun, sira saba, WAV 24-bit ani kisɛ kelen.
creation.setupVideoNote: Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B Q4_K_M bɛ klipw dilan ka bɔ ɲɛfɔli dɔ la. Ladilikan: segin duuru, 21:9 ani 16 FPS. Aw bɛ waati janya, a karamɔgɔ hakɛ, a ɲɛfɔli, a senw ani a kisɛw ladilan. Laɲini janw bɛ klip surunw lajɛ; tigɛcogo yelenw bɛ se ka kɛ. · MP4: Pitɔn + ja-ffmpeg.
creation.setupAllNote: A bɛ modeli ladilikanw telesarse ani k’u labɛn: LFM3-Omni + mmproj sɛbɛnni kama, Qwen3-Embedding Q8_0 kan caman sɔrɔli kama (CPU ka kɛɲɛ ni a daminɛ ye), FLUX.2 Klein 4B ani a yɔrɔw ja dilancogo kama, Real-ESRGAN ×2/×4, ACE-Step ka ɲɛsin dɔnkiliw ma (Instrumental on by default), ani Wan2.1 ka ɲɛsin wideyow ma. Aw ye dosiye hakɛw, disiki yɔrɔ ani wideyow ka ɲininiw lajɛ jukɔrɔ. Téléchargements ni Browse danfaralenw bɛ to yen.
creation.videoDurationNote: Wideyo janw bɛ lajɛ ka bɔ klip surunw na. Tigɛw bɛ se ka ye ani bɔnsɔn bɛ se ka waati jan ta.

Wideyo bɛ baara kɛ ni Diffusers ye. CPU/GPU sugandiliw bɛ danfara la encodeur ni image generator kama motɛriw kɔnɔ minnu sinsinnen bɛ components kan.

creation.ggufImageModel: Yaalacogo misali (GGUF walima min bɛ bɛn Safetensors) .
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Sɛbɛnni-kode (GGUF walima a bɛ se ka kɛ Safetensors) .
creation.ggufVae: VAE (GGUF walima min bɛ bɛn Safetensors)
creation.ggufNote: Aw bɛ diffusion model, texte encoder ani VAE sugandi u danma. FLUX.2 Klein 4B ta fan fɛ, baara kɛ ni Qwen3-4B enkodɔn ye min bɛ bɛn, a GGUF suguyaw fana sen bɛ o la. NVFP4 dosiye minnu bɛ dɛmɛ, olu bɛ labɛn siɲɛ kelen ni Python ani PyTorch ye ka don bɛnkansɛbɛnba dɔ kɔnɔ; fɔlɔw bɛ to u cogo la. O mago bɛ disiki yɔrɔ wɛrɛ la ani RAM. Windows kan, Novera bɛ motɛri don a kɔnɔ ani k’a ɲɛnabɔ a yɛrɛma. Auto bɛ baara kɛ ni fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw ye minnu bɛ sɔrɔ; CUDA mago bɛ CUDA jɔli la. Distilled Klein bɛ baara kɛ ni sen 4 ye cogoya la ani CFG 1. Kisɛya si tɛ telesarse.
creation.ggufWrongModel: Nin GGUF in kɔnɔ, sɛbɛnnikɛlan dɔ bɛ yen. A sugandi encodeur (encodeur) yɔrɔ la ani ka diffusion model (diffusion model) danfaralen sugandi ja foro kɔnɔ.
creation.nativeNote: Native NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Kisɛw lafiyalenw, Qwen3-4B GGUF encoder ani FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE ye baara kɛ ni a ye. A bɛ Blackwell (RTX 50 seriyali walima a bɛ se ka bɛn), Python, CUDA PyTorch ani NVFP4 dantigɛliw de wajibiya. Sɛbɛnni-ka-ja dɔrɔn. Fɛnɲɛnɛma minnu tɛ dɛmɛ sɔrɔ, olu bɛ dɛsɛ k’a jɛya; stable-diffusion.cpp sugandi walasa ka bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma. BF16 jɛnsɛnni cakɛda tɛ yen. Novera bɛ Qwen kalan GGUF dosiye kɔnɔ kelen.
creation.deviceNote: Nin yɔrɔw bɛ ni minɛn sugandili yɛrɛmahɔrɔnyalenw ye. Auto bɛ baara kɛ ni fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw ye minnu bɛ sɔrɔ; native NVFP4 bɛ GPU bɛnkan ɲini tuma bɛɛ ka ɲɛsin sɛnɛko ma ani a bɛ baara kɛ ni GPU sɛbɛnni kodeli ye ni VRAM bɛrɛ ye hɔrɔnya la. Qwen kan CPU bɛ se ka VRAM kisi nka kodɔnni bɛ kɛ dɔɔnin dɔɔnin. Qwen kan GPU bɛ baara kɛ ni layɛrɛ bɔli ye. stable-diffusion.cpp kɔnɔ, Auto bɛ tugu motɛri sugandilen kɔ; ka CUDA wajibiya, o bɛ CUDA jɔli de wajibiya.
creation.totalTimeHint: Waati bɛɛ lajɛlen bɛ doni, sɛbɛnni kodɔn, sɛnɛ, sankaba o sankaba makɔnɔni, telesarse ani marali bɛ o la. Generation dɔrɔn bɛ jira danfara la ni motɛri y’a lakali.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: GPU bɔnsɔn, Qwen3-4B kodɔn CPU kan, sen 4, CFG 1. Kɔrɔbɔli kɛra Windows kan ni Vulkan ye; teliya ni bɛnkan bɛ bɔ i ka minɛnw de la.
creation.seedNote: Sigida ja dɔrɔn. Aw bɛ a suma ni modɛli ni sigida kelenw ye.
creation.imageResolutionMax: A janya hakɛ min bɛ se ka kɛ Novera kɔnɔ: 2048 × 2048 px. Hakilila bɛrɛbɛrɛ de wajibiyalen don.
creation.upscaleInstall: Aw bɛ modeli ofisiyali fila bɛɛ sigi
creation.upscaleNote: Jɛnkulu kɔfɛ. A bɛ Python/PyTorch de wajibiya. A bɔli hakɛ cayalenba: ×2 4096 × 4096, ×4 8192 × 8192.
creation.upscaleMissing: Sigida yɔrɔ wajibiyalenw labɛn ani k’u sɛgɛsɛgɛ Novera · Labɛnw kɔnɔ.
creation.sizeAutoNote: Ni ratio caman cili bɛ sisan ɲɛfɔli bɛrɛbɛn. Dimensions bɛ baara Kɛ ni multiples ye 16, fo ka Se 2048 px ma.
creation.setupTextNvfp4Note: NVFP4 girinya minnu bɛ se ka kɛ NVIDIA Blackwell GPU walima kura sɔrɔlenw ye minnu ka dɔgɔn 4.5 GiB ye VRAM ye. Walasa ka baara kɛ ni nin girinya ninnu ye Novera kɔnɔ, modɛli dafalen marayɔrɔ ka kan ka wuli fɔlɔ ka kɛ NVFP4 GGUF ye min bɛ bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma, ka tiɲɛ. O jiginni in ma Sɛgɛsɛgɛ fɔlɔ nin sɛgɛsɛgɛlikɛyɔrɔ in na. Safetensors filen min bɛ ɲɔgɔn kan, o tɛ se ka doni ka ɲɛsin motɛri jɔlen ma. Q8_0 tora ladilikan labɛnnen ye min bɛ se ka baara kɛ. Hakilila magow fana bɛ bɔ kumasen kɔnɔna janya la.
creation.setupOmniNote: Default bɛ kɛ tabali ni mobili kan. Modeli compact ye sɛbɛnni, ja ani lamɛntaw kama, ka baara kɛ ni {{projector}} file wajibiyalen ye. Télécharger: {{size}} ko la filen fila bɛɛ kama. A sugandi ka kɛ multimodal setup nɔgɔman ye. Kumakan kɛcogo bɛ bɔ plateforme ni moteur de la. Kumasen min ka jan, o bɛ baara kɛ ni hakilijagabɔ caman ye.

instructions.textDefault: Aw ye Novera ye. Jaabi jɛlen, tiɲɛni ani kuma surun kɛ baarakɛla ka kan na. Aw bɛ tugu u ka dantigɛliw kɔ, ka tiɲɛ jɔnjɔnw sɛgɛsɛgɛ ni a bɛ se ka kɛ ani ka dannayabaliya fɔ. Aw kana sɔrɔyɔrɔw, sɔrɔw walima wale dafalenw dabɔ abada.
instructions.imageDefault: Aw bɛ tugu barokun ɲininen kɔ, a kɛcogo ani a karamɔgɔya. Baara kɛ ni sɛbɛnni jɛlenw ye, yeelen min bɛ bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma ani kunnafoni finmanw. Reference identités (daɲɛgafe minnu bɛ tali kɛ ɲɔgɔn na) mara; aw bɛ aw yɛrɛ tanga fɛn tiɲɛnenw ni fɛnw ma minnu man ɲi. Sɛbɛnni fara a kan dɔrɔn ni a ɲinina.
instructions.videoDefault: Aw bɛ tugu barokun ɲininen kɔ, a kɛcogo ani a kuntaala. Aw bɛ fɛnw, fɛnw ani yeelenw to ɲɔgɔn na karamɔgɔya bɛɛ kɔnɔ. Baara kɛ ni lamaga ɲuman ye ani kamera baara min bɛ kɔrɔsi. Aw ye aw yɛrɛ tanga flickers, distortions ani sɛbɛnniw ma minnu ma ɲini.
